CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attested_training(p_dept uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, session_id uuid, start_at timestamp with time zone, end_at timestamp with time zone, optional boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with drill as (
    select
      ts.id,
      ts.department_id,
      -- wall clock -> instant, in the department's zone. See the header.
      (ts.date + coalesce(ts.start_time, '00:00'::time)) at time zone 'America/Chicago' as start_at,
      -- flat 90 minutes, never more than the drill itself ran
      least(interval '90 minutes', make_interval(mins => ts.duration_min))               as credited_len,
      (coalesce(ts.counts_toward_attendance, true) = false)                              as optional
    from public.training_sessions ts
    where ts.department_id = p_dept
      and ts.done                                     -- a drill that has not happened has no hours
      and ts.duration_min is not null                 -- no recorded length, no estimate
      and coalesce(ts.audience, 'everyone') <> 'board' -- a board meeting is not training
      and coalesce(ts.is_offsite, false) = false      -- off-site stays out of station hours
  )
  select
    sa.member_id,
    d.id                       as session_id,
    d.start_at,
    d.start_at + d.credited_len as end_at,
    d.optional
  from drill d
  join public.session_attendance sa on sa.session_id = d.id
  -- LOOSE PREFILTER, on purpose. This is an OVERLAP test, not a containment test:
  -- dept_station_shifts wants drills that START inside the window, while dept_iso_hours
  -- wants any interval that TOUCHES it so a straddling drill can be clipped rather than
  -- dropped. Narrowing this to start_at >= p_from would silently rob the ISO caller of
  -- exactly those rows, so the wider test lives here and each caller narrows its own way.
  and d.start_at < p_to
  and d.start_at + d.credited_len > p_from
  -- OBSERVED WINS. A member who actually checked in has a real interval; the attestation
  -- is not emitted for them at all, which is what stops the same drill being counted twice.
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.station_presence sp
     where sp.kind = 'training'
       and sp.session_id = sa.session_id
       and sp.member_id  = sa.member_id
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_training_presence_on_done()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.station_presence
     set checked_out_at = now()
   where session_id = new.id
     and kind = 'training'
     and checked_out_at is null;
  return null;   -- AFTER trigger: return value is ignored
end;
$function$

dept_iso_hours_by_month(timestamp with t.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_iso_hours_by_month(p_starts timestamp with time zone[], p_ends timestamp with time zone[])
 RETURNS TABLE(idx integer, credited numeric, shifts integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  n integer := coalesce(array_length(p_starts, 1), 0);
begin
  if n <> coalesce(array_length(p_ends, 1), 0) then
    raise exception 'Starts and ends must be the same length.';
  end if;
  if n > 24 then
    raise exception 'At most 24 windows per call.';
  end if;
  -- idx is 1-based, matching the input arrays. Every window gets a row, even an
  -- empty one (credited 0, shifts 0), so the client never mistakes a missing row
  -- for a failed read.
  return query
  select i,
         coalesce((select sum(h.iso_total_hours) from public.dept_iso_hours(p_starts[i], p_ends[i]) h), 0)::numeric,
         (select count(*) from public.dept_station_shifts(p_starts[i], p_ends[i]))::integer
    from generate_series(1, n) as i
   order by i;
end;
$function$

dept_iso_hours_by_station(timestamp with.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_iso_hours_by_station(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, station_id uuid, station_name text, training_hours numeric, standby_hours numeric, iso_total_hours numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_dept uuid := public.my_department_id();
begin
  -- Same gate and same argument validation as dept_iso_hours, deliberately
  -- worded identically so the two cannot drift apart.
  if not public.is_leadership() then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;
  if p_from is null or p_to is null then
    raise exception 'A start and end date are both required.';
  end if;
  if p_from >= p_to then
    raise exception 'The start of the period must come before the end.';
  end if;

  return query
  with clipped as (
    -- A. OBSERVED. Filters copied from dept_iso_hours verbatim — verified,
    -- closed, not auto_closed, standby/training, overlapping the window.
    -- Any divergence here would make the breakdown describe a different
    -- population than the headline.
    select
      sp.member_id                              as mid,
      (sp.kind = 'training')                    as is_training,
      sp.station_id                             as sid,
      greatest(sp.checked_in_at, p_from)        as lo,
      least(sp.checked_out_at, p_to)            as hi
    from public.station_presence sp
    where sp.department_id   = v_dept
      and sp.verified
      and sp.checked_out_at is not null
      and not sp.auto_closed
      and sp.kind in ('standby','training')
      and sp.checked_in_at  <  p_to
      and sp.checked_out_at >  p_from

    union all

    -- B. OFFICER-ATTESTED. No station, ever — sid is a null literal, which is
    -- what puts every attested minute in the Unassigned bucket. `not optional`
    -- and the overlap test mirror dept_iso_hours exactly.
    select
      att.member_id                             as mid,
      true                                      as is_training,
      null::uuid                                as sid,
      greatest(att.start_at, p_from)            as lo,
      least(att.end_at, p_to)                   as hi
    from public.attested_training(v_dept, p_from, p_to) att
    where not att.optional
      and att.start_at < p_to
      and att.end_at   > p_from
  ),
  live as (
    select * from clipped where hi > lo          -- the isempty(span) equivalent
  ),
  -- Every boundary, per member. UNION not UNION ALL: a repeated boundary would
  -- produce a zero-length elementary interval, harmless but pointless.
  bounds as (
    select mid, lo as t from live
    union
    select mid, hi as t from live
  ),
  -- Cut the timeline at each boundary. Between consecutive boundaries the set of
  -- covering spans is constant — the property the whole method rests on.
  elems as (
    select mid, t as lo, lead(t) over (partition by mid order by t) as hi
    from bounds
  ),
  cut as (
    select * from elems where hi is not null and hi > lo
  ),
  attributed as (
    select
      c.mid,
      c.lo,
      c.hi,
      bool_or(l.is_training) as is_training,       -- training if ANY cover is
      -- THE ATTRIBUTION RULE. See the header for the one deviation and how to
      -- revert it.
      (array_agg(l.sid ORDER BY (l.sid is null) asc, l.lo asc, l.sid asc))[1] as sid
    from cut c
    join live l
      on  l.mid = c.mid
      and l.lo <= c.lo
      and l.hi >= c.hi                             -- covers the whole elementary interval
    group by c.mid, c.lo, c.hi
  ),
  per as (
    select
      a.mid,
      a.sid,
      coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (a.hi - a.lo))) filter (where a.is_training), 0) as training_secs,
      sum(extract(epoch from (a.hi - a.lo)))                                           as total_secs
    from attributed a
    group by a.mid, a.sid
  )
  select
    p.mid,
    m.name,
    p.sid,
    st.name::text,
    round((p.training_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2),
    round(((p.total_secs - p.training_secs) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2),
    round((p.total_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2)
  from per p
  join public.members m on m.id = p.mid
  left join public.stations st on st.id = p.sid    -- LEFT: Unassigned must survive
  order by m.name, (p.sid is null) asc, st.name;   -- Unassigned last within a member
end;
$function$

dept_iso_hours_for(uuid,timestamp with t.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_iso_hours_for(p_dept uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, training_hours numeric, standby_hours numeric, iso_total_hours numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_dept is null then raise exception 'A department is required.'; end if;
  if p_from is null or p_to is null then raise exception 'A start and end date are both required.'; end if;
  if p_from >= p_to then raise exception 'The start of the period must come before the end.'; end if;
  return query
  with clipped as (
    select sp.member_id as mid, (sp.kind = 'training') as is_training,
      tstzrange(greatest(sp.checked_in_at, p_from), least(sp.checked_out_at, p_to), '[)') as span
    from public.station_presence sp
    where sp.department_id = p_dept and sp.verified and sp.checked_out_at is not null
      and not sp.auto_closed and sp.kind in ('standby','training')
      and sp.checked_in_at < p_to and sp.checked_out_at > p_from
    union all
    select att.member_id as mid, true as is_training,
      tstzrange(greatest(att.start_at, p_from), least(att.end_at, p_to), '[)') as span
    from public.attested_training(p_dept, p_from, p_to) att
    where not att.optional and att.start_at < p_to and att.end_at > p_from
  ),
  live as (select * from clipped where not isempty(span)),
  agg as (
    select c.mid,
      range_agg(c.span) filter (where c.is_training) as training_mr,
      range_agg(c.span) as all_mr
    from live c group by c.mid
  ),
  secs as (
    select a.mid,
      coalesce((select sum(extract(epoch from (upper(r) - lower(r)))) from unnest(a.training_mr) r), 0) as training_secs,
      coalesce((select sum(extract(epoch from (upper(r) - lower(r)))) from unnest(a.all_mr) r), 0) as total_secs
    from agg a
  ),
  final as (
    select s.mid as mid, m.name as mname,
      round((s.training_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as t_hours,
      round(((s.total_secs - s.training_secs) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as s_hours,
      round((s.total_secs / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as tot_hours
    from secs s join public.members m on m.id = s.mid
  )
  select f.mid, f.mname, f.t_hours, f.s_hours, f.tot_hours from final f
  order by f.tot_hours desc, f.mname;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_iso_hours(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, training_hours numeric, standby_hours numeric, iso_total_hours numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_leadership() then raise exception 'Not authorized'; end if;
  return query select * from public.dept_iso_hours_for(public.my_department_id(), p_from, p_to);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_readiness_packet()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:scorecard — the ISO / audit packet's data, for Board / DA / Officer. Every counted member's verdict + the rollups,
-- built from the existing leadership reads (so the packet matches those screens). Read-only; the UI prints it.
declare v_dept uuid := public.my_department_id(); v_members jsonb; v_reqs jsonb; v_mx jsonb; v_exp jsonb; v_ack jsonb;
begin
  if v_dept is null or not coalesce(public.is_canmanage(), false) then
    raise exception 'Only department leadership can open the readiness packet.';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.readiness_verdict(v_dept, m.id) order by m.name), '[]'::jsonb) into v_members
    from public.members m
   where m.department_id = v_dept and m.status in ('Active', 'Probationary')
     and not coalesce(m.access && array['Project Admin']::text[], false)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.member_separation s where s.member_id = m.id);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) into v_reqs from public.dept_readiness_requirements() r where r.required;
  v_mx := public.dept_qualification_matrix();
  select jsonb_build_object(
           'expired', count(*) filter (where w = 'expired'), 'no_date', count(*) filter (where w = 'no_date'),
           'expiring', count(*) filter (where w = 'soon'), 'current', count(*) filter (where w = 'current'))
    into v_exp
    from (select public.readiness_window(e.bucket, e.expires_on) as w from public.dept_expirations() e) z;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title', c.title, 'version', c.version, 'current', c.current_count, 'audience', c.audience,
                                               'outstanding', jsonb_array_length(c.outstanding)) order by c.title), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_ack from public.dept_read_sign_compliance() c;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'generated_at', now(),
    'department', (select d.name from public.departments d where d.id = v_dept),
    'requirements', v_reqs,
    'standard_set', jsonb_array_length(v_reqs) > 0,
    'members', v_members,
    'readiness', jsonb_build_object(
       'counted', jsonb_array_length(v_members),
       'ready', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_members) x where x->>'state' = 'ready'),
       'not_ready', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_members) x where x->>'state' = 'not_ready'),
       'not_set', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_members) x where x->>'state' = 'not_set')),
    'qualifications', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', t->>'name',
          'qualified', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_mx->'cells') c where c->>'type_id' = t->>'id' and c->>'status' = 'qualified'),
          'in_progress', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_mx->'cells') c where c->>'type_id' = t->>'id' and c->>'status' = 'in_progress'),
          'not_started', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_mx->'cells') c where c->>'type_id' = t->>'id' and c->>'status' = 'not_started')))
        from jsonb_array_elements(v_mx->'types') t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'expirations', v_exp,
    'acknowledgments', v_ack);
end;
$function$

dept_station_shifts(timestamp with time.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_station_shifts(p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT date_trunc('month'::text, now()), p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone, checked_out_at timestamp with time zone, hours numeric, kind text, verified boolean, auto_closed boolean, source text, optional boolean, officer_attested boolean, station_id uuid, station_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_dept uuid := public.my_department_id();
begin
  if not public.is_leadership() then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;
  return query
    -- A. OBSERVED — unchanged except for the two new columns. A real punch is
    -- never "attested": it was measured, and the distinction is the whole point.
    select m.id, m.name, sp.checked_in_at, sp.checked_out_at,
           round((extract(epoch from (sp.checked_out_at - sp.checked_in_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as hours,
           sp.kind, sp.verified, sp.auto_closed,
           coalesce(sp.source, 'geo')::text as source,
           false as optional,
           false as officer_attested,
           sp.station_id,
           st.name::text as station_name
    from public.station_presence sp
    join public.members m on m.id = sp.member_id
    left join public.stations st on st.id = sp.station_id     -- LEFT: never drops a row
    where sp.department_id = v_dept
      and sp.checked_out_at is not null
      and sp.kind in ('standby','training')
      and sp.checked_in_at >= p_from
      and sp.checked_in_at <  p_to
    union all
    -- B. OFFICER-ATTESTED — sourced from attested_training so this and
    -- dept_iso_hours cannot disagree about what an attested interval is. The cap,
    -- the timezone, the four gates and the observed-wins dedup all live there.
    --
    -- hours is the CAPPED interval, not the drill's length: end_at is already
    -- start_at + least(90 min, duration).
    --
    -- The station columns are NULL LITERALS — there is no station to look up.
    select m.id, m.name,
           att.start_at                                  as checked_in_at,
           att.end_at                                    as checked_out_at,
           round((extract(epoch from (att.end_at - att.start_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as hours,
           'training'::text                             as kind,
           false                                        as verified,   -- attested, NOT location-verified
           false                                        as auto_closed,
           'officer_manual'::text                       as source,
           att.optional                                  as optional,
           true                                         as officer_attested,
           null::uuid                                   as station_id,
           null::text                                   as station_name
    from public.attested_training(v_dept, p_from, p_to) att
    join public.members m on m.id = att.member_id
    where att.start_at >= p_from
      and att.start_at <  p_to
    order by 3 desc;                                     -- positional: checked_in_at, unchanged
end;
$function$

expiration_rows(uuid,uuid).def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expiration_rows(p_dept uuid, p_member uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(scope text, source text, item_id uuid, member_id uuid, apparatus_id uuid, subject text, kind text, label text, cls text, expires_on date, days_until integer, bucket text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:expirations (internal) — certs (approved ONLY; never the pending-submission queue) + member_credentials + gear_items + apparatus_tests,
-- one row each, bucketed + ranked. p_member NULL = the department (honest roster); else that member's own rows.
  with td as (select (now() at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date as d),
  people as (
    select m.id, m.name from public.members m
     where m.department_id = p_dept
       and (case when p_member is not null then m.id = p_member
                 else m.status is distinct from 'Inactive'
                      and not coalesce(m.access && array['Project Admin']::text[], false)
                      and not exists (select 1 from public.member_separation s where s.member_id = m.id) end)
  ),
  raw as (
    -- legacy certs: 'YYYY-MM' -> the last day of that month; anything else -> no date
    select 'member'::text as scope, 'cert'::text as source, c.id as item_id, c.member_id, null::uuid as apparatus_id, p.name as subject,
           'cert'::text as kind, c.name as label, null::text as cls,
           case when public.valid_exp_ym(c.exp)
                then (date_trunc('month', to_date(c.exp || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date end as expires_on
      from public.certs c join people p on p.id = c.member_id
     where c.department_id = p_dept
    union all
    select 'member', 'credential', mc.id, mc.member_id, null, p.name, mc.kind, mc.label, mc.cls, mc.expires_on
      from public.member_credentials mc join people p on p.id = mc.member_id
     where mc.department_id = p_dept
    union all
    select 'gear', 'gear', g.id, g.member_id, null, coalesce(p.name, 'Pool gear'), 'gear', g.label, null,
           nullif(least(coalesce(g.next_inspection_on, 'infinity'::date),
                        coalesce((g.in_service_on + interval '10 years')::date, 'infinity'::date)), 'infinity'::date)
      from public.gear_items g left join people p on p.id = g.member_id
     where g.department_id = p_dept and g.retired_at is null
       and (case when p_member is not null then g.member_id = p_member
                 else g.member_id is null or p.id is not null end)
    union all
    select 'apparatus', 'apparatus_test', t.id, null, t.apparatus_id, a.name, t.test_type, t.test_type || ' test', null, t.next_due_on
      from public.apparatus_tests t join public.apparatus a on a.id = t.apparatus_id and a.department_id = p_dept and a.deleted_at is null
     where t.department_id = p_dept and p_member is null
  )
  -- cert catalog: a cert whose type never expires reads 'no_expiry' — no date, satisfied, ranked with current;
  -- never a no_date gap and never expired (whatever its old exp says)
  select r.scope, r.source, r.item_id, r.member_id, r.apparatus_id, r.subject, r.kind, r.label, r.cls,
         case when nx.flag then null else r.expires_on end,
         case when nx.flag or r.expires_on is null then null else (r.expires_on - td.d) end,
         case when nx.flag then 'no_expiry'
              when r.expires_on is null then 'no_date'
              when r.expires_on < td.d then 'expired'
              when r.expires_on - td.d <= 30 then 'soon'
              else 'current' end
    from raw r cross join td
    cross join lateral (select r.source = 'cert' and exists (select 1 from public.certs c left join public.cert_types t on t.id = c.cert_type_id and t.department_id = p_dept
                                                              where c.id = r.item_id and (c.no_expiry or coalesce(t.never_expires, false))) as flag) nx
   order by case when nx.flag then 3 when r.expires_on is null then 1 when r.expires_on < td.d then 0 when r.expires_on - td.d <= 30 then 2 else 3 end,
            case when nx.flag then null else r.expires_on end nulls last, r.subject, r.label;
$function$

is_leadership().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_leadership()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from members
    where lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and members.status in ('Active','Probationary')
      and members.access && array['Project Admin','Department Admin','Board Member','Officer']::text[]
  );
$function$

my_department_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_department_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    -- 1) the saved active station, ONLY if it's still one of the caller's departments
    ( select mad.department_id
        from public.member_active_department mad
       where mad.email = lower(auth.email())
         and exists ( select 1 from public.members m
                       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
                         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
                         and m.department_id = mad.department_id ) ),
    -- 2) else their department, deterministically. Single-dept = byte-identical to the old body.
    ( select m.department_id
        from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
       order by m.department_id
       limit 1 )
  );
$function$

my_member_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_member_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id
  from public.members
  where lower(email) = lower(auth.email())
    and status in ('Active','Probationary')
    and department_id = public.my_department_id()
  limit 1;
$function$

my_station_shifts(timestamp with time zo.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_station_shifts(p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT date_trunc('month'::text, now()), p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS TABLE(checked_in_at timestamp with time zone, checked_out_at timestamp with time zone, hours numeric, kind text, verified boolean, station_id uuid, station_name text, source text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_me uuid := public.my_member_id();
begin
  if v_me is null then
    raise exception 'We could not match your login to a member record.';
  end if;
  return query
    select sp.checked_in_at, sp.checked_out_at,
           round((extract(epoch from (sp.checked_out_at - sp.checked_in_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) as hours,
           sp.kind, sp.verified,
           sp.station_id, s.name as station_name,
           sp.source   -- labelling only (Geofence vs button clock-in). Not a filter.
    from public.station_presence sp
    left join public.stations s on s.id = sp.station_id
    where sp.member_id = v_me
      and sp.checked_out_at is not null
      and sp.kind in ('standby','training')
      and sp.checked_in_at >= p_from
      and sp.checked_in_at <  p_to
    order by sp.checked_in_at desc;
end;
$function$

readiness_items(uuid,uuid).def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.readiness_items(p_dept uuid, p_member uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(requirement_id uuid, kind text, ref_id uuid, label text, satisfied boolean, status text, expires_on date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:scorecard (internal) — every REQUIRED item of the department for one member, each resolved through the existing
-- read for its kind. Read-only.
  with td as (select (now() at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date as d),
  req as (select r.* from public.readiness_requirements r where r.department_id = p_dept and r.required),
  quals as (select c.type_id, c.status from public.qualification_cells(p_dept, p_member) c),
  creds as (select e.kind, e.expires_on, public.readiness_window(e.bucket, e.expires_on) as w
              from public.expiration_rows(p_dept, p_member) e where e.source = 'credential'),
  best_cred as (   -- per kind, the member's best: current > soon > no_date > expired, then the latest date
    select distinct on (c.kind) c.kind, c.expires_on, c.w
      from creds c
     order by c.kind, case c.w when 'current' then 0 when 'soon' then 1 when 'no_date' then 2 else 3 end, c.expires_on desc nulls last),
  ctype as (   -- cert catalog (Slice B): per cert type, the member's best cert of it — no_expiry / current > soon > no_date > expired
    select distinct on (c.cert_type_id) c.cert_type_id, x.expires_on, x.w
      from public.certs c
      join (select e.item_id, e.expires_on, public.readiness_window(e.bucket, e.expires_on) as w
              from public.expiration_rows(p_dept, p_member) e where e.source = 'cert') x on x.item_id = c.id
     where c.member_id = p_member and c.department_id = p_dept and c.cert_type_id is not null
     order by c.cert_type_id, case x.w when 'no_expiry' then 0 when 'current' then 0 when 'soon' then 1 when 'no_date' then 2 else 3 end, x.expires_on desc nulls last)
  select r.id, r.kind, r.ref_id,
         case when r.kind = 'qualification_type' then coalesce(qt.name, 'Qualification (removed)')
              when r.kind = 'document' then coalesce(ds.title, 'Document (removed)')
              when r.kind = 'cert_type' then coalesce(cty.name, 'Cert type (removed)')
              when r.kind = 'credential_license' then 'Driver''s license'
              when r.kind = 'credential_med_card' then 'Med card'
              else 'Fit test' end,
         -- satisfied — NEVER null (bool_and ignores nulls: an unknown must read unsatisfied, not drop out of the verdict)
         coalesce(case when r.kind = 'qualification_type' then coalesce(qt.active, false) and q.status = 'qualified'
              when r.kind = 'document' then ds.series_id is not null and ds.requires_ack and ds.current_version > 0
                                            and (not public.rs_member_in_audience(p_member, ds.required_roles) or ack.ok)
              when r.kind = 'cert_type' then cty.id is not null and cb.w in ('no_expiry', 'current', 'soon')
              else bc.w in ('current', 'soon') end, false),   -- expiring = still valid: satisfied, flagged in renewals_due
         -- status
         case when r.kind = 'qualification_type' then
                case when qt.id is null or not qt.active then 'not_configured'
                     when q.status = 'qualified' then 'qualified'
                     when q.status = 'in_progress' then 'in_progress' else 'missing' end
              when r.kind = 'document' then
                case when ds.series_id is null or not ds.requires_ack or ds.current_version = 0 then 'not_configured'
                     when not public.rs_member_in_audience(p_member, ds.required_roles) then 'not_required'
                     when ack.ok then 'signed' else 'unsigned' end
              when r.kind = 'cert_type' then
                case when cty.id is null then 'not_configured' when cb.cert_type_id is null then 'missing'
                     when cb.w = 'soon' then 'expiring' when cb.w = 'no_expiry' then 'current' else cb.w end
              else case when bc.kind is null then 'missing' when bc.w = 'soon' then 'expiring' else bc.w end end,
         case when r.kind like 'credential\_%' then bc.expires_on when r.kind = 'cert_type' then cb.expires_on end
    from req r cross join td
    left join public.qualification_types qt on r.kind = 'qualification_type' and qt.id = r.ref_id and qt.department_id = p_dept
    left join quals q on r.kind = 'qualification_type' and q.type_id = r.ref_id
    left join public.document_series ds on r.kind = 'document' and ds.series_id = r.ref_id and ds.department_id = p_dept
    left join lateral (select exists (select 1 from public.document_acknowledgments k
                                        where k.member_id = p_member and k.series_id = ds.series_id and k.version = ds.current_version
                                          and (not ds.annual_resign or (k.signed_at at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date + interval '12 months' > td.d)) as ok
                        where r.kind = 'document') ack on true
    left join best_cred bc on r.kind like 'credential\_%' and bc.kind = substr(r.kind, 12)
    left join public.cert_types cty on r.kind = 'cert_type' and cty.id = r.ref_id and cty.department_id = p_dept
    left join ctype cb on r.kind = 'cert_type' and cb.cert_type_id = r.ref_id
   order by case when r.kind = 'qualification_type' then 0 when r.kind like 'credential\_%' or r.kind = 'cert_type' then 1 else 2 end, 4;
$function$

readiness_verdict(uuid,uuid).def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.readiness_verdict(p_dept uuid, p_member uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:scorecard (internal) — the verdict + items + certs (visibility only) + activity (information only). Read-only.
  with it as (select * from public.readiness_items(p_dept, p_member)),
  td as (select (now() at time zone 'America/Chicago')::date as d)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'member_id', m.id, 'name', m.name, 'status', m.status,
    'state', case when (select count(*) from it) = 0 then 'not_set'
                  when (select bool_and(it.satisfied) from it) then 'ready' else 'not_ready' end,
    'required', (select count(*) from it),
    'satisfied', (select count(*) from it where it.satisfied),
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(it)) from it), '[]'::jsonb),
    'outstanding', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(it.label || ' — ' || replace(it.status, '_', ' ')) from it where not it.satisfied), '[]'::jsonb),
    'renewals_due', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', it.label, 'expires_on', it.expires_on)) from it where it.satisfied and it.status = 'expiring'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'certs', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', e.label, 'expires_on', e.expires_on,
                                                           'status', public.readiness_window(e.bucket, e.expires_on)) order by e.expires_on nulls first)
                         from public.expiration_rows(p_dept, p_member) e where e.source = 'cert'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'activity', jsonb_build_object(
      'window', 'last 12 months',
      'station_hours', coalesce((select round(sum(extract(epoch from (sp.checked_out_at - sp.checked_in_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1)
                                   from public.station_presence sp
                                  where sp.member_id = p_member and sp.department_id = p_dept and sp.checked_out_at is not null
                                    and not coalesce(sp.auto_closed, false) and sp.checked_in_at >= now() - interval '12 months'), 0),
      'trainings', (select count(distinct a.session_id) from public.session_attendance a
                      join public.training_sessions t on t.id = a.session_id and t.department_id = p_dept
                     where a.member_id = p_member and t.date <= td.d and t.date > td.d - interval '12 months'),
      'drives', (select count(*) from public.supervised_sessions ss
                  where ss.member_id = p_member and ss.department_id = p_dept and ss.kind = 'drive' and ss.voided_at is null
                    and ss.occurred_on > td.d - interval '12 months')))
    from public.members m cross join td
   where m.id = p_member and m.department_id = p_dept;
$function$

readiness_window(text,date).def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.readiness_window(p_bucket text, p_expires date)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:scorecard (internal) — shared/expiry.js expiryBucket() in SQL: expired / no_date stand; otherwise the expiry MONTH
-- within EXPIRING_MONTHS (3) of this month (America/Chicago) = 'soon', else 'current'. Keep in lockstep with
-- shared/expiry.js + certStatus() (the RETEST checks every month -2..+8).
  select case
    when p_bucket in ('expired', 'no_date', 'no_expiry') then p_bucket
    when p_expires is null then 'no_date'
    when (extract(year from p_expires)::int * 12 + extract(month from p_expires)::int)
         - (extract(year from (now() at time zone 'America/Chicago'))::int * 12 + extract(month from (now() at time zone 'America/Chicago'))::int) <= 3
      then 'soon'
    else 'current' end;
$function$
